title: Periodic Billing and Invoicing Analysis (F3424)
raw_text:
9/29/26, 9:48 AM

Periodic Billing and Invoicing Analysis (F3424)

You can use this app to analyze the billing and invoicing process for all billing and invoicing statuses and KPIs. You can drill down to
a lower level (such as involved contract IDs) and see all relevant analytical information for the respective data at a highly detailed
level. Aggregated information (such as the number of contracts that are ready for invoicing) is also available.

This app is available for the role Billing Specialist (Utilities) (SAP_BR BILLING SPECIALIST ISUv).

Key Features

The app presents the most relevant KPls for a portion-centered analysis of the billing and invoicing process. You can use different
charts to perform a step-by-step analysis of data from different perspectives. You can use a table-based approach to access

transactional content. The chart and table visualizations can also be used to perform a comprehensive analysis and to drill down
through either the chart or table entries to obtain detailed object information.

e Filter the result set using criteria such as:
o Portion (mandatory)
© Scheduled Billing Date (mandatory)
o Contract Account

o Business Partner (a navigation to the business partner overview is available here. In the graphic, select the icon
‘Chart & Table View’, expand the table details, and choose ‘Business Partner’ in the settings)

e Use visual filters to directly see the impact of your filter settings in a chart. The visual filter offers a unique way of filtering
large data sets using visualizations. This helps to recognize facts and situations, whilst reducing the number of interaction

steps needed to gain insights. Visual filters are available for the following KPIs:
o Invoicing Progress
o Invoicing Status
o Billing Progress
o Billing Status

e Youcan make settings to apply specific user configurations to your visualizations, such as sorting, grouping and selecting
columns in your table view. Examples of available fields are:

o Scheduled Billing Date
o Invoicing Progress

o Billing Progress

o Contract

o Rate Category

Supported Device Types
